title.en: Rahu and Ketu change signs on 5 December 2026: Capricorn and Cancer for every ascendant

lead.en: On 5 December 2026 Rahu and Ketu change signs: Rahu moves from Aquarius into Capricorn, Ketu from Leo into Cancer. The new axis holds until 23 June 2028.

text.en: On the fifth of December, Rahu and Ketu change signs. Every chart feels it. So where does it land in yours?

Let's start with what actually moves. Rahu and Ketu are not planets you can see. They are the two crossing points of the Sun's path and the Moon's path. So they always sit exactly opposite each other. On the fifth of December twenty twenty-six, they change signs. Rahu leaves Aquarius for Capricorn. Ketu leaves Leo for Cancer. They walk backwards through the zodiac. And they stay for about eighteen and a half months. That takes us to the twenty-third of June twenty twenty-eight. Now, here is the picture I want you to keep. Rahu turns the volume up. Whatever house it enters, you notice it more. You want more from it. And yes, you can overdo it. Ketu turns the volume down. Whatever house it enters, old habits there go quiet. That can feel like freedom, or it can feel like loss. Two houses, one dial.
One dial, two houses. So who decides how loud it gets?

Good question. The nodes have no signs of their own. So they borrow the voice of the planet that rules their sign. Rahu in Capricorn listens to Saturn. Ketu in Cancer listens to the Moon. That's why this transit feels patient and serious on the Rahu side. And on the Ketu side, it feels personal and emotional. Now, where is Saturn? For a bit more than half of this period, it's in Pisces. It first visits Aries from the third of June twenty twenty-seven. It goes back on the twentieth of October. Then it settles in Aries on the twenty-third of February twenty twenty-eight. So the house Saturn is crossing for you matters. It quietly decides how much of Rahu's appetite becomes something solid. Count the houses from your ascendant. If you know your Moon sign, count from there too. When both point the same way, take that story seriously.
Before we go sign by sign, are there moments that hit everyone at once?

Yes. Four of them. The first opens on the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven. Jupiter moves into Cancer and sits next to Ketu. Jupiter is exalted in Cancer, which means it's at its strongest there. And from there, its seventh aspect falls straight on Rahu in Capricorn. So for about five months, one wise planet touches both ends of the axis. That usually feels like better advice and better timing. Maybe a teacher or a mentor turns up at the right moment. The second mark is a solar eclipse. It falls on the sixth of February twenty twenty-seven, in Capricorn. That's the Rahu side. Eclipses near the nodes act like a spotlight. So the Rahu house in your chart gets loud for a few weeks. The third mark is the summer of twenty twenty-seven. Saturn steps into Aries. And on the second of August, a total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's the Ketu side.
That's three. What's the fourth?

The fourth is the hottest stretch. It runs from the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven. And it lasts until the third of February twenty twenty-eight. Mars travels through Capricorn, where it's exalted. And it sits right on top of Rahu. Mars is drive and courage. Rahu turns the volume up. So this is a few weeks of pure push. It's great for starting hard things. And it's terrible for fights you don't need. Right in the middle, there's another solar eclipse in Capricorn. That's on the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight. Then Saturn returns to Aries in late February. In June twenty twenty-eight, the nodes move on. Rahu goes into Sagittarius, and Ketu goes into Gemini. So remember four marks: late January and early February twenty twenty-seven. Then the summer of twenty twenty-seven. And the turn of the year into twenty twenty-eight.
Good, four marks. Now let's go sign by sign. We start with Aries rising. Where do the two ends fall?

For Aries rising, we count from Aries. Capricorn is your tenth house. That's work, status, and how the world sees you. Cancer is your fourth house. That's home, family, your mother. It's the private ground you stand on. So Rahu turns the volume up on your career. And Ketu turns it down at home. You may want a bigger role, a more visible job, and more responsibility. At the same time, the old routine at home stops feeling like enough. Saturn steers Rahu here. For you, it rules the tenth and eleventh houses. That's work and gains. And for much of this period, it sits in your twelfth house, in Pisces. That often means work behind the scenes, or clients far away. Or effort that gets noticed later, not sooner. Recognition can come. But it rarely comes on the first try.
And when does Aries feel those four marks the most?

The first mark is a gift for you. On the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven, Jupiter enters Cancer. It lands in your fourth house. And it looks straight at Rahu in your tenth. Jupiter rules your ninth house. That's luck, teachers, and the bigger picture. So a mentor or a lucky introduction can link home and career. A move, a renovation, or a family decision may help a career step. It doesn't have to block it. But be a little careful in spring. From the ninth of March to the twenty-sixth of April twenty twenty-seven, Mars is in Cancer. Mars is your own ruling planet. In Cancer it's weak, and it sits with Ketu in your fourth. Short temper at home is the classic trap. So are rushed decisions about property. Keep the big talks for after the twenty-sixth of April. That's when Mars leaves.
Then comes the summer of twenty twenty-seven. What changes for Aries?

The pressure moves onto you personally. On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries. That's your first house. And there, Saturn is debilitated, at its weakest. From Aries, its tenth aspect lands on Rahu in your tenth house. Think of a manager standing behind your shoulder. There's more responsibility and there are more deadlines. And it feels like results depend on you alone. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter moves into Leo, your fifth house. That helps with judgement, study, and children's plans. Then the home end speaks up. On the second of August, the total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's your fourth house, right where Ketu sits. A question about your home or your mother may need calm attention. So keep your promises small, and keep your sleep sacred. Saturn leaves Aries again on the twentieth of October.
And that hot stretch with Mars, at the turn of the year?

For Aries, this is the loudest window of the whole transit. Mars is your own ruling planet. From the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven, it's exalted in Capricorn. That's your tenth house, and Mars sits right with Rahu. Your drive and your hunger for recognition point the same way. Promotions, pitches, and leadership tasks fit this window. Mars also casts its seventh aspect on Ketu in your fourth. So the people at home feel the heat too. The solar eclipse of the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight lands in your tenth as well. Use this energy to show finished work. Don't use it to win arguments with a boss. By the third of February, Mars moves on. Then, from the twenty-third of February, Saturn returns to your first house.
So, Aries rising in one sentence?

Rahu turns the volume up on your career, and Ketu turns it down at home. Your job for eighteen months is to keep both rooms lit. Push at work in late January twenty twenty-seven. Push again at the turn of the year into twenty twenty-eight. Slow down at home in the summer of twenty twenty-seven. And let your own chart decide how strongly each of these lands.
Next up, Taurus rising. Where does the axis fall for you?

For Taurus rising, we count from Taurus. Capricorn becomes your ninth house. That's beliefs, higher learning, long journeys, and teachers. It's also the father and plain old luck. Cancer becomes your third house. That's siblings, neighbours, short trips, and everyday messages. It's also the courage to speak up. So Rahu turns the volume up on the big picture. And Ketu turns it down on the small daily chatter. You may crave a course, a pilgrimage, or a move abroad. Meanwhile, the group chat and the errands can feel oddly flat. Neither end is good or bad. It's simply where the attention goes. Saturn steers Rahu here. For Taurus, it rules both the ninth and the tenth house. That's faith and career in one hand. For much of this period, Saturn sits in Pisces, your eleventh house. That's friends, networks, and income from your efforts. So the people around you can open the bigger door. It often happens slowly, through steady contacts rather than one lucky break.
And the Ketu end, your third house. What goes quiet there?

Mostly the noise. The third house is your daily effort. It's the calls, the emails, the quick trips across town. With Ketu there, you may stop chasing every small task. Some of that is healthy. You simply care less about proving yourself in little ways. But watch the links with brothers, sisters, or neighbours. They can drift without anyone meaning it. Ketu listens to the Moon, because the Moon rules Cancer. And for Taurus rising, the Moon rules that same third house. So your mood and your messages are tied together. On a low day, you may just go silent. That can look like distance, even when it isn't. A short note to a sibling can help more than you expect. One more tip. If you know your Moon sign, count from there too. If both counts point to the same house, trust that reading more.
So when do the marks land for Taurus?

The first one opens on the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven. Jupiter enters Cancer, where it's exalted. It lands in your third house, right beside Ketu. From there, its seventh aspect reaches Rahu in your ninth. For Taurus, Jupiter rules the eighth and eleventh houses. That's shared money and hidden matters, plus gains and friends. So a good word from a friend can move a study plan or a trip. Writing, teaching, and short courses tend to go well here. Then comes the sixth of February twenty twenty-seven. An annular solar eclipse falls in Capricorn, your ninth house. A question of belief, law, or travel may need a clear answer. In spring, slow the pace a little. From the ninth of March to the twenty-sixth of April twenty twenty-seven, Mars is in Cancer. It's debilitated there, and it sits with Ketu in your third. For you, Mars rules the twelfth and seventh houses. That's expenses and rest, and also partners. Sharp words with a partner or a sibling are the classic trap. Sleep on any heated message before you send it.
Then the summer of twenty twenty-seven. What shifts for Taurus?

Saturn changes rooms. On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, it enters Aries. That's your twelfth house, and Saturn is debilitated there. The twelfth is sleep, distance, retreat, and spending. So costs can creep up, and rest matters more. A quiet retreat can do more than a crowded calendar. From Aries, Saturn's tenth aspect lands on Rahu in your ninth. Big plans abroad or in study may meet paperwork and delays. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo. That's your fourth house, so home and comfort get some support. Then, on the second of August, a total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's your third house, where Ketu sits. A conversation or a short trip may need a second look. Keep your words simple and check the details twice. Saturn steps back into Pisces on the twentieth of October.
And the hot stretch at the turn of the year?

This one pulls hard on your ninth house. From the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven, Mars is exalted in Capricorn. It sits right on Rahu. Mars rules your seventh and twelfth houses. So a partner, a foreign place, or a long trip can drive the story. That's a lot of fuel in one place. From there, Mars casts its fourth aspect on your twelfth. Its seventh aspect lands on Ketu in your third. And its eighth aspect touches your fourth house, home. So the energy runs from big plans right down to the kitchen table. The annular eclipse of the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight falls in your ninth too. Do sign up for that course, or book that trip, with a clear budget. Don't turn a difference of belief into a family quarrel. Mars leaves on the third of February. Then, on the twenty-third of February, Saturn settles in your twelfth house.
Taurus rising, in a nutshell?

Rahu turns the volume up on your beliefs, study, and travel. Ketu turns it down on daily chatter and small errands. Push your learning and travel plans from late January twenty twenty-seven. Push again at the turn of the year into twenty twenty-eight. Slow down with spending and sleep from the summer of twenty twenty-seven. And let your own chart decide how strongly this lands.
Gemini rising is next. Where do the two ends fall here?

For Gemini rising, count from Gemini. Capricorn is your eighth house. That's shared money, debts, taxes, and inheritance. It's also deep change and anything hidden. Cancer is your second house. That's your own savings, your food, your voice, and your family table. So Rahu turns the volume up on the joint, the hidden, and the intense. Ketu turns it down on your own purse and daily habits. You may get pulled into research, a loan, or a partner's finances. Meanwhile, regular meals or a saving routine can slip. None of this is fate. It's where your attention tends to drift. Saturn steers Rahu here. For Gemini, it rules your eighth and ninth houses. So it links deep change with beliefs and teachers. For much of this period, Saturn sits in Pisces, your tenth house. That's career and public standing. So hard, careful work tends to carry the eighth house load. Patience at work often pays for what the eighth house asks.
And the second house, where Ketu sits. What does that feel like?

It can feel like loosening your grip on money. Ketu in the second house often cools the urge to save and count. You may eat differently, or speak more bluntly. Family habits around the table can change shape. That's not always bad. Some old patterns there were never really yours. Some people find they simply need less. Still, it's wise to keep a simple budget running. Ketu listens to the Moon, the ruler of Cancer. And for Gemini rising, the Moon rules that very second house. So your mood and your money move together. A tired evening can turn into an impulse purchase. A calm one can bring clear choices about what you truly value. Here's a tip. If you know your Moon sign, count from there as well. When both counts agree, give that reading more weight.
When do the marks reach Gemini?

The first one is generous. On the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven, Jupiter enters Cancer. That's your second house, and Jupiter is exalted there. It sits with Ketu and sends its seventh aspect to Rahu in your eighth. For Gemini, Jupiter rules the seventh and tenth houses. That's partners and career. So a partner or a work contact can help sort shared money. A fair deal on a loan, a contract, or an estate may come within reach. On the sixth of February twenty twenty-seven, an annular solar eclipse falls in Capricorn. That's your eighth house. Hidden costs or old debts can surface, so read the small print. Spring asks for a lighter foot. From the ninth of March to the twenty-sixth of April twenty twenty-seven, Mars is in Cancer. It's debilitated there, next to Ketu in your second house. Mars rules your sixth and eleventh houses. That's daily work and health, and also gains. Impulse spending and harsh words at the table are the classic traps. Wait until Mars leaves before a big purchase.
And the summer of twenty twenty-seven for Gemini?

Saturn brings structure to your hopes. On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, it enters Aries, your eleventh house. Saturn is debilitated in Aries, so gains may come slower than you'd like. Friends and groups can feel like more work. From Aries, Saturn's tenth aspect falls on Rahu in your eighth. Shared money and paperwork get stricter attention. Its third aspect falls on Gemini itself, your first house. You may feel more tired, or simply more serious. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter moves back into Leo, your third house. That helps with writing, learning, and short trips. Then, on the second of August, the total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's your second house, right on Ketu. Money, food, or a family talk may ask for a reset. Keep your spending plain that month, and say less than you feel. In October, Saturn takes a step back. It returns to Pisces on the twentieth.
Now the hot stretch at the turn of the year. How does Gemini handle it?

Carefully, and with a plan. From the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven, Mars is exalted in Capricorn. That's your eighth house, right on Rahu. Mars rules your sixth and eleventh. So work, health, and gains all feed this push. It suits research, debt clearing, and hard negotiations. Mars sends its fourth aspect to your eleventh house. Its seventh aspect lands on Ketu in your second. And its eighth aspect reaches your third house. So friends, savings, and your own words all feel the heat. Tempers can run short around money. The annular eclipse of the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight falls in your eighth as well. Do pay down one debt or settle one shared account. Don't take risky bets with money that isn't only yours. Mars moves on by the third of February. From the twenty-third of February, Saturn settles in your eleventh.
Gemini rising, in one breath?

Rahu turns the volume up on shared money, depth, and change. Ketu turns it down on your own purse and table habits. Push on joint finances from late January twenty twenty-seven. Push again at the turn into twenty twenty-eight, with care. Slow down on spending around the summer eclipse of twenty twenty-seven. And let your own chart decide how strongly each mark lands.
Cancer rising next. This one's personal, isn't it?

Very personal. For Cancer rising, Cancer is your first house. That's your body, your health, and how you meet the world. Capricorn sits opposite, in your seventh house. That's marriage, partners, contracts, and the public. So Rahu turns the volume up on other people. And Ketu turns it down on you. You may want a partner, a deal, or a bigger client. At the same time, your own image may feel less important. You may feel a little less sure of your direction. This isn't a verdict on you. It's a change of focus. Saturn steers Rahu here. For Cancer rising, it rules the seventh and eighth houses. That's partners, and also shared money and deep change. For much of this period, Saturn sits in Pisces, your ninth house. That's teachers, beliefs, and long journeys. So a relationship may grow through study, travel, or a shared philosophy. It tends to ask for commitment rather than a quick spark.
Ketu right on the ascendant. What does that do day to day?

It can make you quieter. Ketu in the first house often turns attention away from the mirror. You may care less about image and more about meaning. Some people simplify their style or their routine. Your body may ask for gentler habits and more rest. Listen to it early, not late. Small signals are easier to answer than big ones. Ketu listens to the Moon, which rules Cancer. And for you, the Moon is the ruler of the whole chart. It rules your first house. So the Moon's daily moods matter twice as much now. Some days can feel clear and light. Others may feel a little lost. A steady sleep time and regular meals help both kinds of days. A tip. If you know your Moon sign, count from there as well. If both counts tell the same story, lean on it.
When do the marks hit Cancer rising?

The first mark lands right on you. On the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven, Jupiter enters Cancer. That's your first house, and Jupiter is exalted there. It joins Ketu and sends its seventh aspect to Rahu in your seventh. For Cancer rising, Jupiter rules the sixth and ninth houses. That's daily work and health, plus luck and teachers. So a wise person can steady both you and your relationships. Good advice on a contract or a partnership may arrive on time. On the sixth of February twenty twenty-seven, an annular solar eclipse falls in Capricorn. That's your seventh house. A partner's choice may need a clear answer from you. Spring is the tender spot. From the ninth of March to the twenty-sixth of April twenty twenty-seven, Mars is in Cancer. It's debilitated there, in your first house, beside Ketu and Jupiter. For you, Mars rules the fifth and tenth houses. That's children and romance, and also career. Fatigue and a short fuse are the classic risks. Pace your work, and keep the big decisions for May.
And when the summer of twenty twenty-seven comes?

The focus moves to your career. On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries. That's your tenth house, and Saturn is debilitated there. Work can feel heavy, and bosses may ask for more. Duties tend to pile up before they ease. From Aries, its tenth aspect falls on Rahu in your seventh. So partners and clients may want firmer commitments. Its seventh aspect lands on your fourth house, home. That can mean a busy job pulling time from family. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter moves into Leo, your second house. That supports savings and a calmer voice. Then, on the second of August, the total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's your first house, right on Ketu. Your health and energy deserve extra care that month. Cut one obligation instead of adding two. Saturn goes back to Pisces on the twentieth of October.
The hot stretch at the turn of the year. What does Cancer feel?

Strong pressure from the other side of the table. From the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven, Mars is exalted in Capricorn. That's your seventh house, right on Rahu. For you, Mars rules the tenth and fifth houses. So business partners, contracts, and public work can heat up fast. It's a strong window for joint ventures. Mars sends its fourth aspect to your tenth house. Its seventh aspect lands straight on Ketu, in your first. Its eighth aspect touches your second, your money and voice. So you may feel pushed, and you may push back. The annular eclipse of the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight also falls in your seventh. Do close one clear deal, in writing. Don't let a partner's urgency set your pace. Mars leaves on the third of February. Then, from the twenty-third of February, Saturn settles in your tenth house.
Cancer rising, in a sentence?

Rahu turns the volume up on partners and contracts, and Ketu turns it down on you. Push in partnerships from late January twenty twenty-seven. Push again, with care, at the turn into twenty twenty-eight. Slow down and rest around the summer eclipse of twenty twenty-seven, when work also gets heavier. And let your own chart decide how strongly each of these lands.
Let's move to Leo rising. The Sun rules your chart. Where do Rahu and Ketu land?

For Leo rising, we count from Leo. Capricorn is your sixth house. That's daily work, health habits, and problems to solve. It's also rivals, debts, and service. Cancer is your twelfth house. That's sleep, spending, rest, and quiet time alone. It's also far places and letting go. So Rahu turns the volume up on your daily grind. And Ketu turns it down on rest and retreat. You may want to fix things, beat a deadline, or outwork a rival. Picture a fuller calendar, a new training plan, and fewer lazy evenings. A tougher job routine or a strict fitness plan can suddenly feel exciting. Rahu in the sixth often handles pressure well. The risk is running on empty. Rest is part of the work, not a reward for later. Saturn steers Rahu here. For you, it rules the sixth and seventh houses. That's work routines and partners. For most of this period, it sits in Pisces, your eighth house. That often points to shared money, deep research, or quiet change. Results come through patience, not through a show.
And the Ketu end, the twelfth house. What goes quiet there?

The twelfth is the room where you switch off. Sleep, private time, prayer, travel, and the money that slips away. With Ketu here, the old ways of escaping can stop working. A favourite holiday may feel flat. Late-night scrolling may feel empty. That can actually be good news. Spending on things you don't need often drops. And quiet practice, like meditation or a long walk, tends to feel natural. Some people notice vivid dreams, or a pull toward solitude. The Moon rules Cancer, so the Moon sets Ketu's tone. For Leo rising, the Moon rules your twelfth house itself. So this whole end of the axis tends to stay private and inward. Your feelings and your need for solitude are linked here. If you know your Moon sign, count from there too. If both counts point to rest, protect your sleep first.
So when do the four marks land for Leo?

The first mark starts on the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven. Jupiter leaves Leo, your first house, and enters Cancer. That's your twelfth, right beside Ketu. Jupiter is exalted there. And its seventh aspect lands on Rahu in your sixth. Jupiter rules your fifth and eighth houses. That's creativity, children, and study, plus shared resources and research. So a calm retreat or a course abroad can help you handle work pressure. On the sixth of February, the annular eclipse falls in Capricorn. That's your sixth house. A work routine or a health habit may ask for a reset. Treat it as a check-up, not a crisis. Then spring brings a softer warning. From the ninth of March to the twenty-sixth of April twenty twenty-seven, Mars is in Cancer. It's debilitated there and sits with Ketu in your twelfth. Mars rules your fourth and ninth houses. That's home, and also beliefs and long trips. So watch for poor sleep, travel mix-ups, and hidden costs at home. Rest before you react.
What about the summer of twenty twenty-seven for Leo?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries. That's your ninth house. Saturn is debilitated there, so it's not at its strongest. Its tenth aspect lands on Rahu in your sixth. So work duties grow heavier, and rules tighten. Studies, travel plans, or a teacher may demand more discipline. Saturn rules your sixth and seventh, so a partner may add to the load. Then some good news. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter returns to Leo, your first house. That often lifts confidence and gives you a clearer head. It stays there until the twenty-sixth of November. On the second of August, the total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's your twelfth house, where Ketu sits. Sleep, spending, or a private worry may need attention. So don't fill every evening. A short quiet break may help more than a big trip. Saturn moves back into Pisces on the twentieth of October.
And the hot weeks around New Year?

From the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven, Mars is exalted in Capricorn. That's your sixth house, and Mars sits right on Rahu. For Leo rising, this is strong fighting energy. Competition, hard training, and clearing a backlog fit this window. Mars casts its fourth aspect on your ninth house. Its seventh aspect lands on Ketu in your twelfth. And its eighth aspect touches your first house, you yourself. So you may push your body harder than it likes. Warm up, sleep enough, and pace the training. This can be the busiest work stretch of the whole transit. The annular eclipse of the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight also falls in your sixth. Do use this window to finish a tough project. Don't pick fights with colleagues to prove a point. Mars leaves on the third of February. Then, on the twenty-third of February, Saturn settles in Aries, your ninth.
Leo rising, in a nutshell?

Rahu turns the volume up on work, health, and competition. Ketu turns it down on escape and spending. Push hard at the turn of the year into twenty twenty-eight. Rest more around the summer eclipse of twenty twenty-seven. Jupiter back in Leo that summer can steady you. Keep your evenings for sleep, not for one more task. Then let your own chart decide how loud it gets.
Moving on to Virgo rising. Which houses get the nodes?

For Virgo rising, Capricorn is your fifth house. That's creativity, romance, children, and study. It's also play, and taking a calculated risk. Cancer is your eleventh house. That's friends, networks, wider groups, and income. It's where your hopes for the future live. So Rahu turns the volume up on self-expression. And Ketu turns it down on the crowd. You may want to write, build, date, or learn something bold. A hobby may start to look like a real project. Meanwhile, group chats and big circles can feel less important. Picture fewer parties, and more evenings on your own project. Rahu here can also make you hungry for attention. Saturn steers Rahu here. For you, it rules the fifth and sixth houses. That's creativity and daily work. For most of this period, it sits in Pisces, your seventh house. That's partners, clients, and contracts. So your creative push often runs through another person. A partner or a client may set the pace and the standards.
And Ketu in the eleventh house. What does that quiet down?

The eleventh is about what you gain from people. Friends, contacts, followers, and the income that comes with them. With Ketu here, chasing numbers tends to lose its charm. You may drop a group that no longer fits. Likes and status in a circle can matter less. The eleventh also holds long-term goals. Some of them may simply stop feeling like yours. That can feel lonely at first. But it often frees time for the fifth house project. The Moon rules Cancer, so it colours Ketu. For Virgo rising, the Moon rules your eleventh house. So the mood of your friendships is the mood of this axis. A few close people may matter more than many loose ones. If you know your Moon sign, count from there too. When both counts agree, that's the story to watch.
When do the big marks hit Virgo?

The first one is generous. On the twenty-fourth of January twenty twenty-seven, Jupiter enters Cancer. That's your eleventh house, right next to Ketu. Jupiter is exalted there. And its seventh aspect falls on Rahu in your fifth. Jupiter rules your fourth and seventh houses. That's home and partnership. So a partner, a family member, or a well-placed friend may back your idea. Friendships can turn more meaningful, even if fewer. On the sixth of February, the annular eclipse lands in Capricorn. That's your fifth house. A creative plan or a matter around children may come into focus. Write the idea down while it's fresh. Spring asks for more care. From the ninth of March to the twenty-sixth of April twenty twenty-seven, Mars is in Cancer. It's debilitated and sits with Ketu in your eleventh. Mars rules your third and eighth houses. That's effort and courage, plus shared money and sudden change. So friction in a group or a messy joint expense is possible. Read the fine print before you sign.
Then summer twenty twenty-seven. What shifts for Virgo?

On the third of June twenty twenty-seven, Saturn enters Aries. That's your eighth house. Saturn is debilitated there. From Aries, its tenth aspect lands on Rahu in your fifth. So creative work and romance get a reality check. Fun projects may suddenly need budgets and deadlines. Children's plans or exams may need more structure. Saturn rules your fifth itself, so this is slow, serious creativity. It's less about fun, and more about craft. On the twenty-sixth of June, Jupiter moves into Leo, your twelfth house. That suits rest, retreat, and quiet study. It stays there until the twenty-sixth of November. On the second of August, the total solar eclipse falls in Cancer. That's your eleventh house, where Ketu sits. A friendship or a group role may close a chapter. Let it go gently, without burning bridges. On the twentieth of October, Saturn steps back into Pisces, your seventh.
And the fiery stretch at the year's turn?

Here Virgo gets a strong creative push. From the twenty-seventh of December twenty twenty-seven, Mars is exalted in Capricorn. That's your fifth house, and Mars sits right on Rahu. Passion, competition, and bold ideas all run hot. Mars aims its fourth aspect at your eighth house. Its seventh aspect lands on Ketu in your eleventh. And its eighth aspect falls on your twelfth. Mars rules your third and eighth, so courage and risk travel together. So a big idea can cost sleep or money if you rush. There's help too. Since the twenty-sixth of November, Jupiter has been in Virgo, your first house. That tends to steady your judgement. The annular eclipse of the twenty-sixth of January twenty twenty-eight also lands in your fifth. Do launch the project you've rehearsed. Don't gamble savings on a hunch. Mars leaves on the third of February. Saturn settles in Aries on the twenty-third of February.
